A.title: How do I feel? Naming feelings
A.differs: K-319 matches faces to feeling words; K-331 circles the face for how you would feel in a picture; K-333 sorts faces into Feels good and Feels bad; K-334 circles the face that shows a word; K-332 draws a feeling face; K-335 circles today's feeling. The groups are printed 'Feels good' / 'Feels bad', not 'uncomfortable'; 'every feeling is OK' is the teacher's message.

A.title: Washing hands and caring for my body
A.differs: K-382 writes 1 to 5 for the hand-washing steps; K-380 draws a line from each child (washing at a tap, a sneeze, under a blanket at night, a hand on messy hair, a fist at the mouth) to the tool that child uses (soap, tissue, bed, comb, toothbrush). The sun hat is not among the tools, and the page does not print '20 seconds'.

A.title: Everyday foods and sometimes foods
A.differs: Draw a line from each food to Healthy or Not Healthy. The groups are printed 'Healthy' / 'Not Healthy', not everyday and sometimes foods, which works against 'sometimes foods are fine for special times'; choosing a picnic snack is the lesson's.

A.title: Crossing the street with a grown-up
A.differs: K-369 reads the lamp that is on (cars and the walking-person / hand signal) and circles what to do; K-373 colors the lit lamp; K-374 numbers the crossing steps 1 to 4 (stop at the curb, look left, look right, walk across). 'Look left again' and holding a grown-up's hand are not among the steps.

A.title: Road signs on the way to school
A.differs: Draw a line from each U.S. road sign (STOP, YIELD, a pedestrian crossing ...) to what it means. Finding the signs on a walk around the block is the lesson's.

A.title: Brushing teeth, stopping germs and my habit chart
A.differs: G1-403 circles before, during or after brushing for each picture; G1-404 circles the way that stops germs in each row (a cough into the elbow, a tissue, an own cup, soap); G1-405 is the week chart of habits to check at home.

A.title: Why we do healthy habits
A.differs: Draw a line from each habit (washing hands, brushing teeth, sleep, moving, sun protection) to the sentence that tells why we do it. Explaining one habit in a full sentence is the lesson's.

A.title: Kinds of road signs and which one fits
A.differs: G2-360 writes the letter of each road sign in the boxes of its group (rule or warning signs by shape and color); G2-361 reads a situation and circles the one sign that fits. What a walker or a bike rider should do at each sign is the lesson's talk.

use.title: I can do it! What I am good at
use.differs: K-345 I Can checks the things a child can do (I can ride a bike, I can sing a song ...) and writes one thing to learn: the 'good at / learning' idea, but as sentences to read, not a drawing, and with no helpers to circle (family, teacher, friend, coach). Change: a picture-only face with a big drawing frame and four helper buttons; level 3's traced 'I can ...' line is new.
use.note: built (Stage D-5 batch K, 2026-11-23): K-705, reviewed by one US Kindergarten teacher in two rounds

use.title: Sleep and play help me grow
use.differs: No sleep-and-play page exists. Build a bedtime strip to cut and order (bath, pajamas, brushing teeth, a story in bed: the routine pictures of G1-478 exist) on the step layout of K-382, and a row of active and still pictures to circle.
use.note: built (Stage D-5 batch K, 2026-11-23): K-706, reviewed by one US Kindergarten teacher in two rounds

use.title: Trusted adults and safe places
use.differs: No trusted-adults page exists. Build eight helpers and three safe places to color and match, and a frame for the child's own trusted adult; the pair layout of K-213 is the closest (most helpers are library pictures, the safe places are new art).
use.note: built (Stage D-5 batch K, 2026-11-23): K-707, reviewed by one US Kindergarten teacher in two rounds

G1-207.title: MyPlate: the five food groups
G1-207.differs: G1-207 sorts foods into four groups (fruits, vegetables, grains, protein): there is no dairy group (cheese was retired from protein) and no MyPlate picture with the dairy cup. Change: a fifth group (milk, yogurt, cheese) and a MyPlate plate as the sorting board.
G1-207.note: a fifth group (milk, yogurt, cheese) and a MyPlate plate as the sorting board.

G1-405.title: Which habit will I grow?
G1-405.differs: G1-405 checks the same five habits (brushing teeth, washing hands, moving the body, drinking water, sleep) every day for a week; the need asks for yesterday only (a sun to color per habit), one habit circled to practice more, and an 'I will ...' line. Small change: a one-day habit-choice face of the same chart.
G1-405.note: a one-day habit-choice face of the same chart.

K-365.title: Sun, heat and cold: dressing for the weather
K-365.differs: K-365 links a cold / warm / hot thermometer to the clothing that fits (scarf, T-shirt, sunglasses) and K-207 sorts summer and winter clothes; neither has sunscreen, shade or a water bottle, a cloudy day, or things that fit more than one weather. Change: a weather-protection match (four weathers, six protections, many lines allowed).
K-365.note: a weather-protection match (four weathers, six protections, many lines allowed).

D.title: Medicines only from a trusted adult
D.differs: No medicine-safety page exists. Build eight pictures (pill bottle, cough syrup, gummy vitamins, spray cleaner / water, apple, milk, sandwich) with a red circle for 'only a trusted adult' and color for everyday foods, and the 'I ask a grown-up first.' line.

D.title: Build a MyPlate lunch
D.differs: Only the food-group sort exists (G1-207, four groups, no dairy); nothing builds a lunch on a divided plate or marks the times of the school day a child chooses food or drink. Far: a MyPlate plate with five parts, a strip of food cards to glue, a drink to circle and a clock strip.
D.note: a MyPlate plate with five parts, a strip of food cards to glue, a drink to circle and a clock strip.

D.title: Health helpers at school and in town
D.differs: No health-helpers page exists. Build six helpers and six workplaces to match on the pair layout of K-213 (the nurse, doctor, pharmacist, firefighter and paramedic are library pictures; the workplaces are new art) and the sentence line.

D.title: Healthy in body, feelings and friendships
D.differs: No wellness page exists. Build three headed columns (a body, a heart, two friends) and nine action cards to cut and glue; the cut-sort-glue layout of K-240 is the closest.

D.title: Who and what influences my choices?
D.differs: No influence page exists. Build the influence web (the child in the middle, six influence bubbles) with six choice cards to glue next to the influence.

D.title: What does this ad want me to do?
D.differs: No media-literacy page exists. Build three pretend ads (no real brands) with the trick to circle, a yes / no 'does it tell me if it is healthy?' and a box to draw an ad for an everyday food.

D.title: My health goal and my helper
D.differs: G1-405 is a week chart to check habits at home, the tracking part only; nothing sets one goal, writes its steps or names the helper, and there is no 14-day strip. Far: a goal page (goal pictures to circle, three step boxes, a 'My helper' box, a 14-day strip of suns).
D.note: a goal page (goal pictures to circle, three step boxes, a 'My helper' box, a 14-day strip of suns).

D.title: When to see the nurse, doctor or dentist
D.differs: No getting-care page exists. Build eight situation pictures (no wounds) to sort with lines into 'see the nurse, doctor or dentist' and 'a grown-up at home can help', and the two checkups to circle; the two-group line sort of K-201 is the closest layout.

D.title: How did my goal go?
D.differs: No goal-reflection page exists. Build the count of colored suns, three faces to circle, 'What helped me was ...' / 'Next I will ...' and keep / change / choose a new goal to circle.

D.title: Stop, think, choose: helmets and life jackets
D.differs: No safety-choice page exists for helmets, scooters and water. Build four choice pairs (helmet on the handlebars or buckled, pool with or without a grown-up, boat with or without a life jacket, sidewalk or street) to circle; the choice rows of G1-404 are the closest layout.

D.title: Be a health helper: our class campaign
D.differs: No health-poster page exists. Build a picture frame, a slogan line, a reason line and a three-box poster checklist.

D.title: How germs spread and how we stop them
D.differs: G1-404 (grade 1) circles the habit that stops germs in each row (a cough into the elbow, a tissue, an own cup, soap): the habits, but not how a germ travels from hand to handle to mouth. Far: a six-frame comic of a germ's trip with the frames to circle where a habit stops it and the habit to write.
D.note: a six-frame comic of a germ's trip with the frames to circle where a habit stops it and the habit to write.

D.title: Fuel for the day: MyPlate meals and drinks
D.differs: No meal-planning page exists. Build four meal boxes with a five-group MyPlate checklist each and everyday / sometimes drinks to mark; G1-207 has only four groups (no dairy).

D.title: Sleep, screens and an hour of play
D.differs: No time-use page exists. Build a strip of the 24 hours of a school day to color from a key (sleep, school, active play, screens) with marks for 9 to 12 hours of sleep and 60 minutes of moving.

D.title: What sways my choices?
D.differs: No influence-analysis page exists. Build six short scenes with the influence to name, healthy / less healthy to circle for the child and the friend, and a 'what I could do' line.

D.title: My goal: plan it, track it, look back
D.differs: G1-405 is a week chart to check habits, the tracking part only, at grade 1; there is no goal plan (why it matters, steps, what I need, who helps), no 21-day chart and no look back. Far: a goal-plan page with a 21-day tracker and a look-back on the back.
D.note: a goal-plan page with a 21-day tracker and a look-back on the back.

D.unit: Safe, Kind and Ready to Help
D.title: Our home fire escape plan
D.differs: G1-530 level 3 is a lettered and numbered grid plate with key rows to draw a map of a room or a school: a surface for a floor plan, but nothing marks two ways out of every room, smoke alarms or the outside meeting place, and there is no family checklist. Far: a home escape-plan page on that grid plate. (G1-530 is not yet published in English.)
D.note: a home escape-plan page on that grid plate. (G1-530 is not yet published in English.)

D.unit: Safe, Kind and Ready to Help
D.title: Who can help? Trusted adults and health resources
D.differs: No help-finder page exists. Build eight situation cards and six helpers to match with lines (the pair layout of K-213 is the closest) and lines for what to say and whom to ask next.
